en: Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a dense military parade of infantry soldiers marching with rifles along a city street lined with ornate multi‑story buildings and packed crowds of spectators. Several mounted officers on horseback accompany the troops. The scene is urban and celebratory. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in French, identifying the event and location as an infantry parade on Rue de la Mésange in Strasbourg on 22 November 1918.
